property.name: Oak Hill Residence
property.title: A residence shaped around the landscape.
property.deck: Long, low stone volumes open onto terraces that follow the contours of the site.
features: Full-height glazing to the main living room
property.place: Los Altos Hills offers a quieter setting within reach of the Peninsula and Silicon Valley. Its winding lanes and open spaces give each property a distinct relationship with the surrounding terrain.

captions.instagram: Oak Hill Residence, Los Altos Hills, California. Long, low stone volumes open onto terraces that follow the contours of the site. Five bedrooms, four and a half baths and 4,320 square feet. Listed at $8,950,000.
captions.x: Oak Hill Residence, Los Altos Hills, California. Five bedrooms, 4,320 square feet, terraces among the oaks. $8,950,000.
captions.linkedin: Oak Hill Residence sits between mature oaks and a quiet ridge in Los Altos Hills. The main living spaces open through full-height glazing to terraces that follow the contours of the site, and a detached studio sits below the house. Five bedrooms, four and a half baths, 4,320 square feet. $8,950,000.
